test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2023: Official Paper (Held On: 14 Aug, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Which is an inherited blood disorder that affects the hemoglobin gene and results in ineffective erythropoiesis.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Thalassemia.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__ Key Points__**

 
• **Thalassemia** is a** genetic disorder** that affects the production of **hemoglobin,** leading to anemia.
